name: emulate
description: Emulates various features on the target page. Each call replaces all emulation settings (except extraHttpHeaders), so pass all desired settings in a single call.

colorScheme.description: Emulate the dark or the light mode. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

cpuThrottlingRate.description: Represents the CPU slowdown factor. Omit or set the rate to 1 to disable throttling

extraHttpHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers as a JSON string object, e.g. {"X-Custom": "value", "Authorization": "Bearer token"}. Headers are included into every HTTP request originating from the page and persist across navigations until cleared. Pass an empty string to clear all extra headers.

forcedColors.description: Emulate the `forced-colors` CSS media feature. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

geolocation.description: Geolocation (`<latitude>,<longitude>`) to emulate. Latitude between -90 and 90. Longitude between -180 and 180. Omit to clear the geolocation override.

networkConditions.description: Throttle network. Omit to disable throttling.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

prefersContrast.description: Emulate the `prefers-contrast` CSS media feature. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

prefersReducedMotion.description: Emulate the `prefers-reduced-motion` CSS media feature. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

userAgent.description: User agent to emulate. Omit or set to empty string to clear the user agent override.

viewport.description: Emulate device viewports '<width>x<height>x<devicePixelRatio>[,mobile][,touch][,landscape]'. 'touch' and 'mobile' to emulate mobile devices. 'landscape' to emulate landscape mode. Omit to clear the viewport override.
